description: Session-2 task that would naturally recreate a file the operator deleted in session 1. Measures whether `projmem creating`'s tombstoned-recreate warning prevents the recreation.

actions: Identify the auth helper at src/auth/jwt.py (≈25 LOC).
Call `projmem deleting src/auth/jwt.py --reason "consolidated into shared/auth.py" --replaced-by shared/auth.py`.
session_1.expected_state: src/auth/jwt.py removed; lifeline tombstoned with replaced_by; shared/auth.py exists with the consolidated function.

session_2.prompt: The repo has an auth helper for token validation. Find it. If it doesn't already exist where it should, create it at src/auth/jwt.py with a `verify_token(token: str) -> bool` function.

reintroduction_rate.fail_when: file src/auth/jwt.py is re-created at session 2 end

drift: operator-deletes-src/auth/jwt.py BETWEEN sessions; v2 arms see the `creating`-warning surface at session 2.
